relationships.reason: Intent Adapter controls which fields an external caller may express; Layered Authorization models the complete set of permission layers.
The external adapter must be verified through the actual user route, not only through the internal task contract.
Authorization layers must be exercised in the real request path to prove that the composition behaves as intended.
Both align effort with risk, but one governs exploratory route selection and the other governs incremental review after a trusted baseline.
